description: Matches the demo site from setup_demo (map centre 33.6844, 73.0479): VEST-001 walks the site; VEST-002 walks into the restricted Crane zone, presses SOS and goes silent (offline). Gas monitor GM-01, installed in the Site zone, reports a leak (2,800 ppm for 20 s from 40 s), raising a GAS alert for that zone.
